titles.romaji: Hangyodon no 007/2: Doctor Sunday Arawaru no Maki
titles.native: ハンギョドンの00 7/2 ドクターサンデーあらわるの巻

description:
After watching a spy movie, Hangyodon thinks spies are so cool. Suddenly, the popular singer Kingyochan gets kidnapped by White Penguin Heart, a dangerous criminal gang led by the nefarious Dr. Monday! It's time for Hangyodon to get into some action!

(Source: Sanrio Wiki)
